decision: Descriptive screen only. Require submitted input and rendered token fingerprint equality, length and warm cached tokens equality, under 3ms arrival drift, and both paired starts meeting TPOT p50 and pooled visible gap p95 ratios <=1.0 in all four cells. Report identity output differences independently. A failed or missing cell is not parity. Two starts cannot replace the five-pair qualification. Preserve any tool/quality errors separately.
